newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-FAC to look at upgrading Canberra Airport.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-FAC to look at upgrading Canberra Airport.

text.p: Australia's Federal Airports Corp (FAC) would investigate the feasibility of upgrading Canberra Airport to international standards, Transport Minister John Sharp said on Wednesday.
The FAC would look at upgrading Canberra Airport for both passenger and freight operations, Sharp said in a statement.
Sharp said the FAC would focus on what additional facilities were needed for international operations as well as the potential demand for such an operation.
